collection.description: A severe wound has begun to spread illness through a patient's body; removing the injured limb might save their life.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A severe wound has begun to spread illness through a patient's body; removing the injured limb might save their life.

choices.label: Offer surgery and explain the consequences.
Treat the wound without removing the limb.
Let the patient decide after hearing both possibilities.

text_only.reason: the premise: it happened before the event; nobody is harmed now

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The patient consents and survives, beginning a difficult adjustment to daily life without running.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The patient survives the operation but later dies from infection.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The illness recedes, though the limb remains weak.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The illness spreads, and the patient dies with family nearby.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The patient declines surgery and requests comfort care.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The patient chooses surgery and later trains apprentices in a new craft, though running is now hard.
